authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan sources, focusing on underetymologised and smaller sources first for greater diversity. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have unlimited time now

proposals.evidence: Buddruss p26 item16 explicitly derives ac from *az from *aj, comparing the same z > c change elsewhere in Grangali. Turner242 adya gives regional aj/az today through MIA ajja. This source-explicit consonant development supports the existing today family without normalizing the installed affricate.

proposals.evidence: Buddruss p31 item97 gives Grangali byeλ, with another collection’s bel, beside Shumashti wyel and Gawri yel. Turner11625 vikāla evening gives Pashai vyāl/vel, Gawri yel and regional byäl forms. The b-y-l family and night sense support this assignment. The source lambda transcription is retained; unlike Shumashti, no specific loan route is established for this Grangali record.
